programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Brennan es capturado y cae bajo el control de Eckhart, quien se ve obligado a trabajar contra los Nuevos Mutantes.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Mutante X acude en ayuda de una adolescente Mutante Nueva perseguida por rusos porque tiene el secreto de una nueva arma que tiene como objetivo a los mutantes.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Shalimar se vuelve más cercana a otro salvaje cuando es "lujuria a primera vista", pero las cosas se complican cuando su nuevo novio intenta encontrar una cura para su condición.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Un nuevo mutante es secuestrado de su familia, y Mutante X se propone recuperarlo y averiguar cuál es el interés de Eckhart con él.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Cuando una plaga que solo afecta a los mutantes se desata, Adam y Eckhart aceptan trabajar juntos para encontrar una cura.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Eckhart busca un mutante que pueda absorber energía, uno con el que Brennan se involucre románticamente.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Jesse se enamora de un pirata informático, a quien Eckhart quiere "procurar" para corromper los canales de noticias informáticos públicos contra los Nuevos Mutantes ... y en beneficio de la GSA.

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.title: Face the Nation
programme.desc: "Face the Nation," which is one of the longest-running news programs on the air, offers insight and analysis on the top issues of the day. Moderator Margaret Brennan welcomes politicians, government leaders and international newsmakers to a roundtable discussion of current events with CBS News correspondents.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programme.title: Ted Curson
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap & Alex Wilson
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a "Solo Piano Summit," audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The "Solo Piano Summit" brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson. Besides solo performances the all-stars used the occasion for spontaneous interplay, improvisation and a fantastic finale - in short for the pleasure of virtuoso jazz piano playing.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Richard Easley, Thornel Schwartz & Jimmy McGriff
programme.sub-title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres. His sound - deep, down-to-earth grooves drenched in blues and gospel feeling - made him popular with R&B audiences. This 1965 performance is part of the Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Charles Mingus
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Michel Legrand
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra. During this 1982 performance in the Belgian town of Spa, Legrand leads his orchestra through a number of original songs, including “The Summer Knows,” “What Are You Doing the Rest of Your Life?” and “Les Moulins de mon Cœur.” Singing either in English or French, Legrand delivers a spirited performance with plenty of romantic flair that is sure to capture your heart.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver's quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: “Adjustment”, “Barbara”, “In Pursuit of the 27th Man”, and “Song For My Father”. Tune in and let Horace Silver's irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Frankie Dunlop & John Ore
programme.sub-title: Thelonious Monk live in Palais des Beaux-Arts
programme.desc: Thelonious Monk: Live in '65 features an intimate concert filmed in Belgium in the winter of 1965 with a legendary quartet that includes drummer Frankie Dunlop, bassist John Ore and tenor saxophonist Charlie Rouse. Thelonious Monk revolutionized jazz with his innovative musical approach and these remarkable performances allow viewers the rare opportunity to experience Monk's genius up close as he performs his classic compositions Monk's Dream, Epistrophy and Rhythm-a-Ning.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, John Ore & Frankie Dunlop
programme.desc: Thelonious Monk: Live in '65 features an intimate concert filmed in Belgium in the winter of 1965 with a legendary quartet that includes drummer Frankie Dunlop, bassist John Ore and tenor saxophonist Charlie Rouse. Thelonious Monk revolutionized jazz with his innovative musical approach and these remarkable performances allow viewers the rare opportunity to experience Monk's genius up close as he performs his classic compositions Evidence and Bright Mississippi.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja & Ensemble Musica Aeterna
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Carlos Santana
programme.desc: With a momentous career stretching back into the sixties, Santana has led the way in introducing initially Latin rhythms and styles and later influences from worldly cultures into the world of mainstream rock music. Along the way they have collected numerous awards, accrued multi-million album sales and garnered a string of top hit singles. Masterfully filmed in Montreux, Switzerland in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classic tracks from early hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" through to their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". This is undoubtedly the have-to-have definitive Santana live concert. Music video by Carlos Santana __© 2011 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Sharknado 2: The Second One

programme.title: In Time

programme.title: The Bounty
programme.desc: The story of a 1789 mutiny on the H.M.S. Bounty in which a voyage to Tahiti turns a crew against its Captain when they find tropical paradise and unlimited sex, but the Captain decides to leave and take his crew on a perilous voyage around Cape Horn.

programme.title: Spooks: The Greater Good
programme.desc: When a terrorist escapes custody during a routine handover, Will Holloway must team with disgraced MI5 Intelligence Chief Harry Pearce to track him down before an imminent terrorist attack on London.

programme.title: Godsend
programme.desc: A couple agree to have their deceased son cloned, but bizarre things happen several years after his rebirth.

programme.title: Insidious
programme.desc: A family tries to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further.

programme.title: Insidious
programme.desc: The Lamberts believe they have defeated the spirits haunting them, but evil is not beaten so easily.

programme.title: Insidious
programme.desc: A gifted psychic reluctantly agrees to use her ability to contact the dead in order to help a teenage girl.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: In 1978, one film changed the face of cinema forever. Long established as one of the most debated and divisive movies of all time, I Spit On Your Grave has been condemned by some as 'vile and depraved', whilst others hail it as a 'misunderstood masterpiece of cinema', 'the ultimate feminist movie'. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

Mickey is torn between the freedom she craves and the love she has for her father. As a toxic relationship with her addict father forms and in a desperate search for independence and her own identity, she risks family, heartbreak, and her standing in the only place she can call home.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Alone. Afraid. Shut In. Get ready for an intense thrill ride of survival at any cost! A young mother finds herself barricaded inside a pantry by her violent ex. With her kids on the other side of the door and the impending threat of violence, she must do whatever it takes to escape and get her kids out of the house.

programme.title: The Owners
programme.desc: One night in 1990s rural England, a retired couple finds their isolated house besieged by a gang of young criminals. The thieves think it will be easy to make them give up the secret of their safe. But they have no idea what nightmare they've gotten themselves into as they fight to escape the house alive.

programme.title: Blood Harvest
programme.desc: Hysteria, secrets, blame and judgement, it's time for a blood harvest. In an idyllic 1873 American Protestant village times are harsh and the grass is always greener on the other side. As the village suffers, one woman prospers and there are grumblings that she may be in league with the devil. Blood and secrets are shed and the cost of survival is revealed in this descent into the supernatural.

programme.title: A Good Woman is Hard to Find
programme.desc: A dynamic killer thriller, firmly on the pulses of stark social commentary, Abner Pastoll (director of Road Games) crafts a dazzling, dark and daring journey through Northern Irelands criminal underbelly. Widowed Sarah (tour de force Sarah Bolger: Emelie) is desperate to know who murdered her husband. Coerced into helping a drug-dealer, she takes drastic action to protect her kids.

programme.title: The Match
programme.desc: "The Match" tells the story of the true events which transpired in the spring of 1944 when Nazis organized a football match between the Hungarian prisoners and an elite Nazi team to commemorate Adolf Hitler's birthday.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: Under the Mistletoe

programme.title: Secret Lives of Second Wives

programme.title: Wuthering Heights (1970)
programme.desc: A passionate adaptation of Emily Brontë's superbly strange and hauntingly enduring classic novel, starring Timothy Dalton and Anna Calder-Marshall as the doomed and deathless lovers, Heathcliff and Cathy. Directed by Robert Fuest.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: When Sarah Goldman, a lovely young school teacher in Chicago, wants to please her parents, she invents a boyfriend whom she believes will be the man of her mother's dreams. When her parents insist on meeting the man, Sarah hires Bob, an actor, to pretend to be her "beau". The masquerade works flawlessly for a time and brings comic situations, but in the end, their lives are irrevocably changed.

programme.title: Not Cinderella's Type
programme.desc: Indy lives with her aunt and uncle and believes her life is fine until an accident brings a new guy into her life. Bryant Bailey is not Indy's type - she's never been into guys like him. But then again, she's never really known anyone so stubborn and caring that can also help her discover who she is and what she's worth. A modern telling of Cinderella, based on the novel by Jenni James.

programme.title: Made For You with Love

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap & Alex Wilson
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a "Solo Piano Summit," audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The "Solo Piano Summit" brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson. Besides solo performances the all-stars used the occasion for spontaneous interplay, improvisation and a fantastic finale - in short for the pleasure of virtuoso jazz piano playing.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Richard Easley, Thornel Schwartz & Jimmy McGriff
programme.sub-title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres. His sound - deep, down-to-earth grooves drenched in blues and gospel feeling - made him popular with R&B audiences. This 1965 performance is part of the Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Charles Mingus
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Michel Legrand
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra. During this 1982 performance in the Belgian town of Spa, Legrand leads his orchestra through a number of original songs, including “The Summer Knows,” “What Are You Doing the Rest of Your Life?” and “Les Moulins de mon Cœur.” Singing either in English or French, Legrand delivers a spirited performance with plenty of romantic flair that is sure to capture your heart.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver's quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: “Adjustment”, “Barbara”, “In Pursuit of the 27th Man”, and “Song For My Father”. Tune in and let Horace Silver's irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Frankie Dunlop & John Ore
programme.sub-title: Thelonious Monk live in Palais des Beaux-Arts
programme.desc: Thelonious Monk: Live in '65 features an intimate concert filmed in Belgium in the winter of 1965 with a legendary quartet that includes drummer Frankie Dunlop, bassist John Ore and tenor saxophonist Charlie Rouse. Thelonious Monk revolutionized jazz with his innovative musical approach and these remarkable performances allow viewers the rare opportunity to experience Monk's genius up close as he performs his classic compositions Monk's Dream, Epistrophy and Rhythm-a-Ning.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, John Ore & Frankie Dunlop
programme.desc: Thelonious Monk: Live in '65 features an intimate concert filmed in Belgium in the winter of 1965 with a legendary quartet that includes drummer Frankie Dunlop, bassist John Ore and tenor saxophonist Charlie Rouse. Thelonious Monk revolutionized jazz with his innovative musical approach and these remarkable performances allow viewers the rare opportunity to experience Monk's genius up close as he performs his classic compositions Evidence and Bright Mississippi.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja & Ensemble Musica Aeterna
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Beyoncé
programme.desc: The Sound Of Change was a benefit concert held at Twickenham Stadium, London, England, as part of the Chime For Change initiative, founded by Beyoncé with the help of actress Salma Hayek and Gucci's creative director, Frida Giannini.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: “Sum Of The Parts” is the official authorised story of Genesis made with the full co-operation of the band members. It explores the dynamics of the group that has enabled them to survive changes of line-up, see their musical direction steadily evolve and maintain both group and solo careers along with their enduring popularity as evidenced by their hugely successful 2007 reunion tour.

programme.title: Carlos Santana
programme.desc: With a momentous career stretching back into the sixties, Santana has led the way in introducing initially Latin rhythms and styles and later influences from worldly cultures into the world of mainstream rock music. Along the way they have collected numerous awards, accrued multi-million album sales and garnered a string of top hit singles. Masterfully filmed in Montreux, Switzerland in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classic tracks from early hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" through to their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". This is undoubtedly the have-to-have definitive Santana live concert. Music video by Carlos Santana __© 2011 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

Pero lo que comenzó como un viaje de negocios de rutina descarrila en inimaginables caminos.

programme.title: St. Vincent

La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: El Club de la Lucha

programme.title: Sin escapatoria

programme.title: Camino hacia la libertad
programme.desc: Un día, un olor familiar distrae al perro de su cometido. Es su dueño Joshua que ha llegado como un prisionero más. El Pastor Alemán no puede traicionar a su amo y le ayudará a huir. Juntos vivirán un duro y largo viaje hacia la libertad y la búsqueda de su hogar.

programme.title: Un hombre de familia
programme.desc: Ésta es la emotiva historia de un hombre en busca de la redención. Un empresario de alto nivel (Gerard Butler) recibe la oportunidad de controlar su compañía de trabajo, pero para lograrlo tendrá que poner a su familia de por medio.

programme.title: La casa de los espíritus
programme.desc: >A mediados del siglo XX en Chile, Esteban logra salir de la pobreza y convertirse en el exitoso dueño de un negocio. Sus maneras estrictas y tradicionales se oponen a las de los jóvenes revolucionarios, entre los cuales se encuentra el joven Pedro, quien está enamorado de su hija.

programme.title: Monos
programme.desc: En la cima de una imponente montaña, donde lo que a primera vista parece un campamento de verano, ocho niños guerrilleros apodados “Los Monos» conviven bajo la atenta mirada de un sargento paramilitar. Su única misión es clara: cuidar a la doctora, una americana a la que han tomado como rehén.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa

programme.title: Siete días y una vida

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso

programme.title: El bosque de los sueños
programme.desc: Un estadounidense (McConaughey) y un japonés (Watanabe) se conocen en el tristemente famoso "bosque del suicidio", un lugar al que la gente va para quitarse la vida. Tras entablar conversación, abandonan sus proyectos de suicidio y juntos emprenden un viaje a través del bosque.

programme.title: Bajo cero
programme.desc: El gobierno de Estados Unidos encarga a John Deckert que reúna a sus colaboradores más cualificados para que escalen la cara norte del pico más alto de la cordillera Himalaya, el K2. La misión es localizar en su cima un dispositivo para activar satélites nucleares, robado de una base de las Naciones Unidas por unos terroristas que lo dejaron caer al ser derribado el avión en el que viajaban.

programme.title: Buenas noches, mamá
programme.desc: Es pleno verano y dos hermanos gemelos esperan pacientemente a que su madre regrese a casa tras una operación de cirugía plástica. Cuando llega con la cara completamente vendada, se muestra fría, distante y obsesiva. El cambio en su personalidad hará que los niños se pregunten si la mujer que ha llegado es realmente su madre o se trata de una impostora.

programme.title: Mercenary
programme.desc: Jonas Ambler es un rico hombre de negocios cuya esposa es asesinada por un comando terrorista.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Rivales
programme.desc: Dos equipos juveniles van a la final en Sevilla mientras se entrelazan historias familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Gun Shy
programme.desc: Rockero rescata a su esposa secuestrada en Chile.

programme.title: Adivina quién
programme.desc: Cuando Theresa trae a su prometido, Simon Green, a casa para el 25.º aniversario de boda de sus padres, se olvida de mencionar un pequeño detalle: es blanco. Decidido a romper el compromiso de su hija, Percy Jones demuestra que el padre no siempre sabe lo que hace.

programme.title: De vuelta a casa
programme.desc: Alice (Reese Witherspoon) es una mujer recién separada que decide enfrentarse a nuevos retos y vuelve a Los Ángeles para construirse una nueva vida. Un nuevo trabajo que no es exactamente lo que ella esperaba, un colegio nuevo para sus hijos y facturas que pagar.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Tripp Kennedy entra tranquilamente en una sucursal bancaria poco antes de la hora de cierre, justo en el momento en que dos bandas distintas convergen por casualidad con intención de realizar un atraco. Todos ellos quedan atrapados en el edificio durante una noche que promete acción y diversión...

programme.title: Entonces llegaste tú
programme.desc: Una viuda solitaria plantea realizar un viaje alrededor del mundo con las cenizas de su marido para visitar los sitios que ambos adoraban en sus películas favoritas.

programme.title: El Patrullero 777
programme.desc: Cantinflas es un agente de policía que debe mantener el orden en la ciudad, pero la diversión está asegurada cuando las cosas empiezan a desmadrarse.

programme.title: Entrega Inmediata
programme.desc: Mientras trabaja de cartero, una preciosa chica rubia se acerca a Cantinflas y le pide que entregue una carta muy importante en la planta nuclear de la ciudad. Cantinflas está encantado de ser de ayuda, pero no sabe que la chica es una espía y que la carta contiene secretos nucleares codificados.

programme.title: Locos De Remate
programme.desc: Richard Pryor y Gene Wilder protagonizan en una desopilante comedia sobre dos convictos que intentan por todos los medios de escapar de la cárcel.

programme.title: No Me Mientas Que Te Creo
programme.desc: Los populares cómicos Richard Pryor y Gene Wilder son un par de mentirosos patológicos hechos el uno para el otro.

programme.title: Los murciélagos
programme.desc: Un grupo de misteriosos criminales enmascarados llega a un pueblo y siembra el terror entre sus habitantes. Mientras el miedo se apodera de la comunidad, una amenaza oculta desafía a quienes se atrevan a enfrentarlos y descubrir quiénes se esconden tras las máscaras.

programme.title: El Zorro de Jalisco
programme.desc: Un misterioso justiciero enmascarado se enfrenta a un despiadado villano conocido como “el Indio”. En una lucha marcada por el peligro y la venganza, ambos se convierten en protagonistas de un intenso enfrentamiento donde la justicia deberá abrirse paso ante la amenaza.

programme.title: Entre bala y bala
programme.desc: Un asesinato y la lucha por recuperar unas tierras perdidas esconden un misterio que nadie parece dispuesto a revelar. Entre secretos, intereses enfrentados y peligros inesperados, descubrir la verdad será clave para desentrañar lo ocurrido y recuperar aquello que alguna vez perteneció a alguien.

programme.title: Persecución mortal
programme.desc: El pistolero Silver es contratado por un abogado para demostrar que su cliente, Chester Conway, es inocente del atraco a la taberna por el que ha sido condenado a la horca.

programme.title: Sólo el valiente
programme.desc: Un despreciado comandante de caballería es injustamente culpado por su tropa de la muerte de un popular oficial y debe redimirse ante sus hombres durante un ataque indio al fuerte.

programme.title: El Experimento del Terror
programme.desc: Un terrorista detona una explosión en un edificio federal y libera gas tóxico. Su objetivo es exponer un arma secreta: un virus de guerra biológica que ataca el sistema suprarrenal y vuelve a las personas violentamente incontrolables.

programme.title: Asesinos a Sueldo
programme.desc: Traicionado por quienes más confiaba, un asesino a sueldo novato del gobierno descubre que ahora es el objetivo del sicario más letal del mundo. Sin aliados y contra el reloj, comienza un juego despiadado donde matar primero es la única forma de sobrevivir.

programme.title: Lethal Virus
programme.desc: El cambio climático ha liberado un antiguo virus de la rabia atrapado en el hielo de la Antártida. Una científica intenta llegar al laboratorio para crear una cura para salvar el mundo.

programme.title: Los héroes de las Ardenas
programme.desc: La historia real de la heroica experiencia de Don Smith en la Batalla de las Ardenas, cuando formaba parte del 94º de Infantería.

programme.title: The Princess Blade
programme.desc: Yuki pertenece a un grupo de guerreros mercenarios, los Takemikazuchi, largamente empleados por el actual gobierno para vencer a la facción rebelde contrarios a su política déspota. Esta banda de samurais modernos se rige por un sólido código del honor mas cercano a las antiguas ordenes feudales que a una organización pseudo-criminal. Yuki, descendiente directa de la rama consanguínea de los fundadores del clan descubrirá que su madre fue asesinada por el actual dirigente del mismo cuando intentó poner fin a las maniobras de sus miembros. Consciente de ello Yuki se volverá contra sus camaradas y tendrá que liberarse de sus deberes para ser libre.

programme.title: La maldición 2
programme.desc: El fantasma de Kayako sigue al acecho. Tatsuya Suzuki, un agente de bienes raíces, le pide a su hija Kyouko que vaya a la casa en la que Kayako y Kobayashi fueron asesinados (y donde también se produjo la desaparición de la familia Murakami). Kyouko logra ver el fantasma de Kayako y esto le da motivo para iniciar su propia investigación sobre los hechos, llegando a la conclusión que Kayako fue muerta en la casa de Kobayashi. Tatsuya vende la casa encantada al matrimonio de los Kitada.

programme.title: Exorcismo en Georgia
programme.desc: Poco después de trasladarse a su nueva casa en Georgia una pareja se entera de que su hija tiene misteriosas visiones de personas que nadie más que ella parece ver. Finalmente ellos también son testigos de extraños fenómenos que tienen lugar alrededor de la casa y que van aportando pistas de lo que podría ser un escalofriante misterio que se ha mantenido en secreto durante generaciones.

programme.title: The convent. El convento del diablo
programme.desc: El colegio femenino de St. Francis fue cerrado hace décadas debido a una horrible historia que allí sucedió. Una joven llamada Christine al parecer asesinó a varias monjas y un sacerdote, y ahora vive aislada en una de las casas del pueblo. El convento sirve de marco para innumerables leyendas, y tradiciones como pintar las letras del colegio en la torre antes de comenzar el juego de la hermandad escolar. Un grupo de amigos decide ir al viejo edificio para realizar la pintada y de paso tener allí una pequeña fiesta. Pero aparece una pareja de policías, y los jóvenes deben irse del lugar, dejando allí sola a una de las chicas. Cuando regresen, se encontrarán con que terribles fuerzas habitan el lugar...

programme.title: La Hermandad
programme.desc: En un apartado monasterio vive una hermandad de monjes benedictinos. Se ocupan de curar a Sara, una famosa escritora de novelas de terror y misterio, tras un grave accidente. Muy pronto Sara empieza a observar ciertos detalles que llaman su atención.

programme.title: Negociador

programme.desc: Un traficante de drogas de poca monta se topa con un baño que lo hace retroceder en el tiempo.

programme.desc: Faith está orgullosa de ser por fin policía en su ciudad natal de Stillwater, Oklahoma. Se une a Paul, su antiguo amor, en el cuerpo de policía y se preocupa cuando él se involucra sentimentalmente con Jessica, una belleza errática con un pasado criminal. Entonces, cuando Jessica tiene una aventura con un joven impresionable, Faith debe construir un caso contra Jessica antes de que Jessica destruya la vida de Paul.

A principios del siglo XX, China se encuentra en crisis. El país está dividido en facciones enfrentadas, los ciudadanos pasan hambre y las recientes reformas políticas han empeorado la situación. La dinastía Qing, gobernada por un emperador de siete años y su despiadada madre, la emperatriz viuda Longyu, está completamente desconectada tras 250 años de poder incuestionable. Huang Xing acaba de regresar de Japón, donde estudió el arte de la guerra moderna. Al ver a su país desmoronarse, siente que no tiene otra opción que tomar las armas.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee
programme.desc: China, año 665 d.C. La dinastía Tang está siendo amenazada por el reino coreano de Buyeo. Por ello, se envían barcos de guerra como advertencia. Sin embargo, la flota queda reducida a cenizas antes de llegar a su destino, supuestamente por el ataque del Dragón del Mar. La emperatriz ordena resolver el misterio de la desaparición de la flota de forma inmediata. El joven Dee llega ese mismo día para ocupar un puesto en el Departamento de Justicia.

programme.title: Una amenaza en la sombra
programme.desc: Wes Rawlins es un cazarecompensas y hombre de pocas palabras. Queda devastado cuando su madre es asesinada por una pareja de forajidos.

programme.title: Perfect weapon (Arma Perfecta)
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, una organización gubernamental y secreta dirigida por EL DIRECTOR controla todos los aspectos de la vida. Todos “los enemigos del estado” son castigados de manera severa y muchos de ellos son ejecutados mediante asesinos de la organización.

programme.title: Los mercenarios
programme.desc: Barney Ross es un veterano de guerra que ha reunido a un grupo de mercenarios de élite para operaciones puntuales de rescate. Siguiendo un encargo que proviene de altas esferas gubernamentales, el grupo se dirige a una república latinoamericana con la misión de derrocar a un dictador despiadado.

programme.title: El tren de las 3:10
programme.desc: Dan Evans, un ranchero de Arizona y veterano de la Guerra de Secesión, escolta al forajido Ben Wade para ganar dinero. La tensión aumenta cuando se enfrentan a la violencia y a los cómplices de Wade. Nominada a dos Oscar en 2008.

programme.title: El Ultimo Soldado Americano
programme.desc: Tras caer prisionero en la jungla de Vietnam, el "Comandante" consigue escapar.

programme.title: Amenaza Terrorista
programme.desc: Un agente británico debe localizar y eliminar a un terrorista suicida y a su célula nacida en el país.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Mercenarios protegen tecnología mortal y rescatan a la hija de un CEO secuestrada por terroristas.

programme.title: Boone: El cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Inferno

programme.title: Monster Hunter

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hollywood
programme.desc: Érase una vez... en Hollywood de Quentin Tarantino, nos traslada a Los Ángeles de 1969, donde todo está cambiando, y donde la estrella de la televisión Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio), y Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt), su doble desde hace muchos años, se abren camino en una industria que ya prácticamente no reconocen. La novena película del célebre escritor y director cuenta con amplio reparto y múltiples tramas argumentales que rinden un tributo a los momentos finales de la época dorada de Hollywood.
